description: A white swan is a thing to throw at

participation.context: Said the house should not hide, and named Heminges as the first of the three.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Called from Holywell, set the two men at sixpence and the chain after the play, and yielded on the flag.
participation.name: Cuthbert Burbage

participation.context: Walked the playhouse with a lantern. He was not on the call. His son reported him.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Not on the call. You said the flag had been his opinion first.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.quote: Then it's three to one. God keep you.

story.body: You took the call at home. You kept the flag up, and you left the two men and the chain as he had set them.

relations.quote: Then it's three to one. God keep you.

title: Kept the flag up

participation.context: Played in Fair Em and set the strip down after.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You played from the cue-strip. You did not carry the morning's list onto it.
